decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy artifacts onto the battlefield, leveraging cards like Emry and Urza's Saga to generate value and create a board presence. The deck combines aggressive artifact creatures with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Chalice of the Void to control the game and put pressure on the opponent. By utilizing artifacts and efficient card draw, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and synergistic strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control spells and removal to manipulate the game state and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes powerful counter spells like Force of Will and Pyroblast, along with versatile removal options like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. Additionally, the deck features card advantage engines like Sylvan Library and Life from the Loam to help maintain resources. With a mix of control elements and card advantage, this Bant Control deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on using the Bomberman combo of Auriok Salvagers and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate infinite mana, which can be used to cast Walking Ballista for lethal damage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Karn, the Great Creator to control the game and protect the combo. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key pieces of the combo and Mishra's Bauble provides card advantage. The deck is designed to quickly assemble the combo and win the game in explosive fashion.

The deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent, with a strong emphasis on direct damage spells and aggressive creatures. With a low mana curve and a high density of burn spells, the deck aims to end the game as quickly as possible by overwhelming the opponent with direct damage. The efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide help put pressure on the opponent while spells like Price of Progress and Fireblast provide powerful finishers.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Cloudpost and Tron lands, allowing for the early deployment of powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Eldrazi creatures. It also includes utility cards like Pithing Needle and Crop Rotation to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to control the board through its ramping abilities and big creatures, eventually overwhelming the opponent with its superior mana resources and threats. The inclusion of cards like Endurance and Green Sun's Zenith provide additional flexibility and resilience against various strategies.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hate bears and removal while using Aether Vial and Urza's Saga to generate value and tempo. It aims to establish a board presence quickly and apply pressure through efficient creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in the late game. With a mix of disruptive threats and powerful equipment, the deck seeks to control the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling the Doomsday combo quickly and efficiently to win the game. It uses various spells to set up the perfect stack of cards from the library, such as Personal Tutor and Ideas Unbound. Once the combo is activated, Thassa's Oracle is cast to win the game. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Duress to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies. The mana base is built around fetching key lands like Underground Sea and Polluted Delta to ensure smooth gameplay.

The deck focuses on using Doomsday to set up a winning combo using cards like Thassa's Oracle and Street Wraith to win the game. It aims to draw through the deck quickly, using cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the necessary pieces. Protection is provided through Force of Will and Pact of Negation. The deck also includes mana acceleration with Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual. The key is to efficiently set up the Doomsday combo, protect it, and win the game in a quick and decisive manner.

The key concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana and card draw by playing a large number of elf creatures that synergize with each other. This allows the player to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for a powerful combo finish, often utilizing cards like Natural Order and Green Sun's Zenith to search for key creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Regal Force. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a massive board state and finish the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on assembling a specific combination of cards in order to win the game, with the end goal being to use Thassa's Oracle to win instantly by having an empty library. It includes a mix of counterspells, card draw, and mana acceleration to protect the combo and dig through the deck efficiently. The deck aims to disrupt opponents while setting up its win condition quickly and reliably, making sure to have the necessary pieces in place to execute the combo when the time is right.

The deck focuses on using Cloudpost and Tron lands to efficiently ramp up mana and control the game through powerful creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. With cards like Pithing Needle and Expedition Map for utility and searching, the deck aims to easily find and play its key threats quickly. By utilizing cards like Elvish Reclaimer and Primeval Titan to search for specific lands, the deck can create a dominant board presence and overwhelm opponents with its high mana production and powerful threats.

This UR Tempo deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal. It aims to control the pace of the game by playing efficiently costed creatures like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also utilizing powerful spells such as Force of Will and Lightning Bolt to protect and support its board presence. By applying pressure early on and maintaining tempo throughout the game, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and secure victory through aggression and disruption.
